cases.assertion: Valid existing environment is reused without rewriting its immutable receipt.
A configured environment without the setup receipt fails and persists all observed commands.
A receipt with a different runId is rejected.
A receipt with a different containerId is rejected.
A receipt with a different database is rejected.
A mismatching observed database marker is rejected.
An observed PostgreSQL 16 version is rejected.
An existing attempt failure survives a later identity-guard failure unchanged.
A failure before the generated config is written retains command observations without generated password or environment values.
Successful simulated creation writes the expected receipt and records each nested command once.
Missing --database produces a failure record with zero database commands.
A successful command notifies its observer exactly once.
A nonzero command notifies before throwing and retains the same error.observation.
A simulated unstarted child records exitCode null and processStarted false before throwing.

originalExecution.invocation: PowerShell literal here-string piped to Node stdin

limits: The 14 cases execute the real setup/runtime JavaScript bodies with injected in-memory filesystem, database identity, Docker, SQL and process doubles.

The setup observer registration and teardown, exclusive failure persistence, receipt checks and command observer notification paths are exercised; PostgreSQL, Docker and migration behavior are not exercised.
The original stdin run emitted aggregate completion only. The archived replay binds the saved probe and both tool source hashes before and after its actual execution.
This supporting report is separate from every real PostgreSQL Phase008 Gate case and does not increase the eight-case Gate numerator.
